prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: original panoramic key illustration for the existing Solo Healer mobile RPG website, for an editorial page introducing solo raid healing to players who enjoy the healer role.
Input images: Image 1 is the game's current sanctuary illustration, a world, painterly rendering and palette reference only. Image 2 is an actual game cathedral environment, an architectural reference only. Create a new scene, do not edit those images.
Primary request: A healer keeps a small adventuring party alive in an ancient cathedral dungeon. This must read immediately as the quiet courage of being the healer, rather than a battle poster about a warrior.
Scene: a ruined pale-stone cathedral aisle and a distant arched doorway, a few sunflowers and climbing vines reclaiming the edges, teal-blue shadow and a warm shaft of light. One original robed healer is seen from behind at mid-distance, hands casting a beautiful flowing thread of warm gold healing light toward a shield-bearing companion ahead. Two other small companions stand further along the aisle, one with a bow and one with a staff. All figures are original, human-scale, readable but secondary to the sweeping environment, no detailed faces required. The arc of healing visually connects the party.
Style: refined hand-painted 2D fantasy key art, tactile brushwork, believable stone and cloth, atmospheric depth, matching the supplied Solo Healer art, restrained emerald-teal shadows and luminous amber gold, premium cinematic fantasy illustration, hopeful and tense rather than grim.
Composition: very wide 2.4:1 landscape, entire small party in the center-right two thirds; the leftmost third is a naturally dark, calm stone arch and shadow with breathing room for live website text. Strong depth leading toward the doorway. The healer and the healing arc remain recognizable if the central region is cropped for a mobile view.
Constraints: no words, letters, UI, interface panels, numbers, health bars, logos, watermarks, recognizable characters or emblems from any other game. No fake gameplay screenshot. No red medical cross, no ornate border, no floating weapons. This is a standalone original marketing illustration, not World of Warcraft art.
